name: deliver
description: Spec, build, and ship AI agents — PRD templates (prd --mode roadmap for roadmaps), instruction design, prompt engineering, sprint planning, context budget, stakeholder mapping, build-execution scaffolding (harness-design, parallel-team worktrees, build-loop), prompt-level progress tracking (velocity, estimate, blocker-detect, track --mode checkpoint), UI/UX design-system enforcement (DESIGN.md, RESPECT.md), and async stakeholder review via ask-team --mode review. Use when writing agent PRDs, building agents, communicating progress to stakeholders, or enforcing design quality during the build cycle.
